title: [PDDF] Unable to use desel with CPLDMUX
author: bluecmd
body:
#### Description

The following code makes it clear that the use case of setting `cpld_desel` is not supported by the standard driver.
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/9b769244d58bdc76a4074e2ddd7e64901323673f/platform/pddf/i2c/modules/cpldmux/driver/pddf_cpldmux_driver.c#L30-L36

Why is that? With PDDF being close to removing needs for custom drivers it seems odd that such a minor thing would be case for a driver fork.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Have a CPLDMUX that requires a deactivation write
2. Try to implement it in PDDF
3. Realize it is implemented but deactivated without possibility to activate

#### Describe the results you received:

The CPLDMUX does not work.

#### Describe the results you expected:

The CPLDMUX can be implemented with PDDF and works.

#### Output of `show version`:

N/A

#### Output of `show techsupport`:

N/A

#### Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):

N/A

#### Why I did it

This feature was meant to be enabled but was accidentally left disabled.

I also changed the default log level for normal usage to KERN_INFO as the log spam can be quite severe otherwise.

##### Work item tracking

Fixes #14546.

#### How I did it

Enabled the option by default.

#### How to verify it

 - Requires a PDDF CPLDMUX driver.
 - Access an I2C bus through the CPLDMUX
 - Observe the message that the bus was deselected.
